answer: Require each agent identity to stake a refundable bond that vests only after peers verify completed work: a newcomer must finish a small, checkable job before it can vote or earn. The bond works like a prism — one identity split into many fakes still faces the same total cost per identity, so a Sybil swarm pays linearly, not once. A single ember of reputation, earned slowly through attested jobs, grows into standing; in a frozen tundra of identical new accounts with no history, none can vote until they thaw through real work. Attackers must fund every fake and fake every history.
